snippet.title: Is Portugal Becoming Anti-American? Portugal’s New Immigration Law Explained
snippet.description:
Portugal just changed one of the biggest reasons people moved here… citizenship. For years, Portugal became one of the most attractive countries in Europe for expats, retirees, and digital nomads because of its relatively fast path to citizenship. But now Portugal has officially changed the law, increasing the timeline from 5 years to 10 years for most foreigners — and the REAL timeline could become even longer because of residency approval delays.

In this video, we break down what changed, why Portugal made this decision, whether the country is becoming anti-expat, the difference between permanent residency and citizenship, and whether Portugal is still worth moving to after these changes. We also share something personal: our Portuguese citizenship application was submitted about six months before the law changed, meaning we are still on the old pathway. If you’ve ever considered moving to Portugal, living in Europe, or getting a second passport, this is a video you need to watch.

Spending more than you’d like on food delivery or last-minute restaurant runs? You’re not alone. In this video, I’m breaking down the 7 simple shifts I made to save money on food while eating out—without feeling deprived or stuck eating the same three meals on repeat.
From sneaky emotional triggers to practical budget hacks, I’ll show you how to curb your takeout habit, plan smarter meals, and still enjoy food you actually like. This isn’t about guilt—it’s about getting intentional with your spending and freeing up cash for the things that matter.
If you’re tired of watching your bank account slowly drain thanks to Deliveroo, Uber Eats, and overpriced café lunches, this one’s for you.
Whether you’re trying to pay off debt, save for a goal, or just eat more at home without the stress, I’ll walk you through mindset shifts and money habits that work in real life.

• How I cut over £200/month without giving up fun meals

• Budget-friendly food swaps that actually taste good

snippet.title: Credit Cards & Crypto: A Risky Mix?
snippet.description:
Navigating the world of cryptocurrencies can be thrilling, but using credit cards to fund your investments is a risky gamble! In this video, we explore the potential dangers of leveraging credit to invest in crypto. With the market's notorious volatility, borrowing money to speculate can lead to spiraling debt and financial distress. 

We’ll break down key considerations, like assessing your risk tolerance and understanding safer investment strategies. Whether you're a seasoned investor or just starting, make informed decisions that align with your financial goals. Don't let the allure of quick profits blind you to the risks!
